_comment: Clubs that have held a seat. `sheetLabels` are the spellings used in the workbook's Club/Venue columns; `abbreviations` appear in the secretary's award letters. firstSeasonCertain/lastSeasonCertain=false means the year is the first/last we have a record of, not a documented start/end.

clubs.name: Longue Vue Club
clubs.seatNote: Longue Vue holds the fourth seat by 1995, the earliest surviving post-war record. It replaced Allegheny Country Club at some point in the undocumented 1955-1994 stretch.

clubs.name: Allegheny Country Club
clubs.seatNote: Joined in 1946 as the fourth club. 1954 is the last season with a surviving record; when Allegheny left and Longue Vue took the seat is unknown.
